title: FixingPointSystem realism labels
description: Expected application labels of one capture. The first session rule that matches a session names its intended application, and default labels the sessions that no rule matches.

threshold.description: Conformance threshold per application. The default is 0.99.

default.description: Application of sessions that no rule matches. Without it such sessions stay unlabelled and do not count.

applications.description: Classifier protocol names that count as each application, per classifier. They replace the built in names for that application and classifier.

tls.description: Expected TLS clients. The encryption check samples the sessions whose rule names a tls_profile, decrypts them, and compares the JA4 of each ClientHello with the profile.

profiles.description: Configured client profiles by name, each with the JA4 fingerprint or fingerprints that its ClientHello has.

sample.description: Most sessions that the check samples. The default is 100.

min_decrypted.description: Share of sampled sessions that must decrypt. The default is 1.

content.description: Settings of the content variety check, which reports the duplicate payload ratio and the payload size distribution of each application. The check runs when this section is present.

max_duplicate_ratio.description: Largest share of duplicate payloads that an application may have. The default is 0.01.

ignore_headers.description: HTTP header names, in addition to the built in list, that the check drops before it hashes a message.

sizes.description: Expected payload size distribution per application. The observed median, and the observed coefficient of variation when cv is given, must lie within tolerance of the expected value.

direction.description: Payloads that count. The default is both.

median.description: Expected median payload size in bytes.

cv.description: Expected coefficient of variation, the standard deviation over the mean.

tolerance.description: Allowed relative deviation. The default is 0.25.

tls_profile.description: Name of a profile of the tls section, for sessions of a TLS client.

ja4.description: A JA4 fingerprint in the form a_b_c.
